title: Hotels Near Don Mueang Airport (DMK), Bangkok 2026 — 7 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 7 closest hotels to Don Mueang Airport (DMK) in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Don Mueang, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for layover, early-flight and late-arrival travellers.
ogDesc: The 7 closest stays to Don Mueang, with real distances and prices.
intro: Don Mueang (DMK) is Bangkok's second airport and the home base of low-cost carriers like AirAsia, Nok Air and Thai Lion Air. Most people flying from here get an early-morning or late-night slot, so they want a hotel close by with an airport shuttle. The hotels around Don Mueang mostly sit on the Song Prapha side and along Vibhavadi Rangsit Road, just 2–6 km from the terminal and a few minutes' drive. The closest of all is Amari, which links straight to Terminal 1 by skywalk. Below are places we checked are real and genuinely bookable, with real distances to the terminal and honest shuttle notes (free or paid, and which runs), ordered cheapest to priciest.

blocks.html: Short answer: For an early-morning or late-night Don Mueang flight, the only place you can actually walk to the terminal is Amari Don Muang, linked by a roughly 7-minute skywalk to Terminal 1 (Amari runs no airport shuttle because you simply walk across). Everything else is a budget hotel around Song Prapha–Vibhavadi, 2–6 km out, with a free scheduled shuttle — The Prima Residence, 12 The Residence, Room Quest and Best Western Nada among them. SweetLoft and Don Muang Hotel are the cheapest, under ฿1,000 for a short night before a flight.

blocks.text: Hotels near Don Mueang, by distance & budget

items.name: SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang
items.meta: 📍 12-min shuttle (5 km) to Don Mueang · ★ 3-star · Best for: Tightest budget · short night before a flight · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: One of the cheapest in the area, from around 650 THB, with simple, clean air-conditioned rooms and a fridge. It suits anyone who just needs a bed overnight before an early flight. There's a shuttle to Don Mueang, about 5 km and a 12-minute ride away, but it runs at set times rather than 24 hours, so check the schedule and book it with the hotel ahead — for a very late flight you may need to grab your own taxi.

items.name: Don Muang Hotel
items.meta: 📍 5-min shuttle (800 m) to Don Mueang · ★ 2-star · Best for: Close to the airport · cheap · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel on Soi Saranakhom, only about 800 m from the terminal — very close, though the road isn't a comfortable walk, so most people use the hotel shuttle, which costs 35 THB per person and starts running from 4 a.m., handy for a pre-dawn flight. Rooms are basic at around 750 THB a night, and reviews call it good value for a quick stopover. A fit if you want the cheapest bed genuinely near the airport, as long as you're fine that the shuttle isn't free.

items.name: 12 The Residence Hotel & Apartment
items.meta: 📍 8-min shuttle (4 km) to Don Mueang · ★ 3-star · Best for: Low-cost flights · breakfast included · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On the Song Prapha side, about 4 km from Don Mueang and an 8-minute ride, with a free morning shuttle to the airport. Rooms are clean and a step newer than the cheapest places, breakfast is included, there's a 24-hour gym, and the in-house Japanese restaurant gets good mentions in reviews. A fit for low-cost flyers who want a slightly nicer room and a meal before the airport — the shuttle runs on a morning schedule, so ask the hotel about timing for a late flight.

items.name: The Prima Residence
items.meta: 📍 6-min shuttle (2 km) to Don Mueang · ★ 3-star · Best for: Early departures · spacious, quiet rooms · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: About 2 km from Don Mueang, a 6-minute ride, with a free scheduled shuttle to the airport. Reviews praise the spacious, clean, well-designed rooms and a quiet, peaceful setting, and breakfast is included. It suits an early departure when you want a full night's sleep somewhere calm before heading to the terminal, and it's one of the better-value picks in the area — the shuttle runs at set times, so check the schedule and reserve ahead.

items.name: Room Quest Don Mueang Airport
items.meta: 📍 6-min shuttle (3 km) to Don Mueang · ★ 3-star · Best for: Free shuttle · transit stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 3-star hotel about 3 km from Don Mueang, a 6-minute ride, with a free airport shuttle that reviewers repeatedly call punctual and genuinely useful for early flights. Rooms are clean with a fridge and balcony, and staff are helpful. It suits a single transit night when you don't want any uncertainty about getting to the airport — confirm the shuttle times with the hotel for your flight, as it runs in set rounds.

items.name: Best Western Nada Don Mueang Airport Hotel
items.meta: 📍 15-min shuttle (5 km) to Don Mueang · ★ 3-star · Best for: International brand · near the Red Line · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A Best Western-brand hotel about 5 km from Don Mueang, around a 15-minute ride, with a free airport shuttle from 5 a.m. that needs to be pre-booked. You get reliable chain standards with clean, newer rooms, and it's a few minutes' walk from a Red Line commuter-rail station, so you can head into the city too. It fits travellers who want a familiar brand and aren't only flying but continuing into Bangkok — the shuttle is morning-only, so use Grab for a late flight.

items.name: Amari Don Muang Airport Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 7-min walk via skywalk (450 m) to Don Mueang · ★ 4-star · Best for: Closest to the terminal · walk across · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The hotel right next to Don Mueang, directly across from the airport and linked by a roughly 450-metre skywalk to the 2nd floor of Terminal 1 — about a 7-minute walk, no shuttle needed (Amari runs no airport shuttle precisely because you can walk across). It has an outdoor pool, gym, restaurants and solid 4-star rooms. It's the pick for maximum peace of mind on timing: for a pre-dawn departure or a late arrival you can simply wheel your bag across at any hour. Rates run higher than the others here, but you're paying for a genuine walk to the gate.

faq.q: Which hotel is closest to Don Mueang and lets you walk into the airport?
faq.a: Amari Don Muang Airport is the closest to the airport — directly opposite Don Mueang with a roughly 450-metre skywalk to the 2nd floor of Terminal 1, about a 7-minute walk, so you can wheel your bag across at any hour without waiting for a shuttle. It's ideal for a pre-dawn departure or a late arrival. The other hotels in the area are 2–6 km out and rely on a shuttle or Grab.

faq.q: Is the airport shuttle free, and does it run 24 hours?
faq.a: It depends on the hotel. Several — The Prima Residence, 12 The Residence, Room Quest and Best Western Nada — offer a free shuttle, but most run on a morning schedule rather than 24 hours, so check the times and book ahead with the hotel. Don Muang Hotel's shuttle costs 35 THB per person but starts from 4 a.m. For a very late flight or one before the first run, it's safer to plan on a Grab — the fare from this area to the terminal is only a few tens to just over a hundred baht.

faq.q: I have a pre-dawn flight and want a cheap, clean bed for one night — what should I pick?
faq.a: For just one night before an early flight, the cheapest in the area are SweetLoft Hotel from around 650 THB and Don Muang Hotel at about 750 THB, which is only 800 m from the airport. For a slightly nicer room with breakfast, look at 12 The Residence or The Prima Residence at about 850–900 THB, both with a free morning shuttle. And if you most want the certainty of walking into the airport yourself at any hour, choose Amari, which connects to the terminal by skywalk.
